title: Cloudflare WARP
ip.label: IP
unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm traffic goes through Cloudflare
why.not_installed: Install downloads the client from Cloudflare, verifies it and registers this device.
why.service_stopped: The background service isn't running, so WARP can't connect.
why.daemon_unresponsive: The background service is running but didn't answer.
why.not_registered: WARP needs a free registration before it can connect.
why.not_through_cloudflare: WARP says it's connected, but Cloudflare sees your traffic arriving from outside WARP.
why.dns_broken: Lookups time out. Usually DNSOverTLS=yes set by hand in resolved.conf.
why.dns_bypassed: WARP lost its DNS settings, so lookups go to your usual resolver.
why.dns_shared: Another network, such as Tailscale, also handles all domains.
